# Fixtures

Every `.gcode` file here is real slicer output, not hand-written. Nothing in this directory is
shipped in the wheel; it exists so the tests run against files with the same quirks a user's files
have.

The models are `examples/cylinder_40mm.stl` and `examples/cylinder_6mm.stl`, generated by
`python tools/make_stl.py`. `examples/vase_40mm.stl` is the demo model, not a fixture.

| file | slicer | what it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prusaslicer_normal_40mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | the worked example, absolute E, 200 layers |
| `prusaslicer_vase_40mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | the worked example, spiral vase |
| `orcaslicer_normal_40mm.gcode` | OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 | relative E, `M73` progress, `CONFIG_BLOCK` |
| `orcaslicer_vase_40mm.gcode` | OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 | spiral vase, including the ramp-down block at the final Z |
| `prusaslicer_normal_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | small pair, used where 200 layers are overkill |
| `prusaslicer_vase_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | small pair, spiral vase |
| `klipper_normal_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | klipper flavor with `SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO` markers |
| `klipper_vase_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | the same, spiral vase |
| `klipper_absolute_normal_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | klipper flavor with absolute E, for the `sim/` comparison |
| `klipper_absolute_vase_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | the same, spiral vase |
| `arcfit_normal_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | 1231 `G2`/`G3` arc moves |
| `mismatch_layerheight_6mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | 0.3 mm layers, must be refused |
| `shifted_placement_1mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | same object moved to 130,130, must be refused |
| `two_objects_1mm.gcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | two instances with `objects_info`, must be refused |
| `bambustudio_normal_40mm.gcode` | BambuStudio 02.08.02.61 | config block at the top, `; CHANGE_LAYER` / `; Z_HEIGHT:` markers, retraction split between a wipe and an E-only tail |
| `bambustudio_vase_40mm.gcode` | BambuStudio 02.08.02.61 | the same, spiral vase |
| `binary_6mm.bgcode` | PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 | binary G-code, must be refused |

## Regenerating

Download the portable builds, then run the commands below. `PS` is
`PrusaSlicer-2.9.6/prusa-slicer-console.exe`, `ORCA` is `orca-slicer.exe` and `BAMBU` is
`bambu-studio.exe`. `P` is the vendor folder under that slicer's `resources/profiles`.

```sh
python tools/make_stl.py -o cyl40.stl
python tools/make_stl.py -o cyl6.stl --height 6 --radius 8 --segments 48
python tools/make_stl.py -o cyl1.stl --height 1.2 --radius 8 --segments 48

# PrusaSlicer pairs
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 \
    --output prusaslicer_normal_40mm.gcode cyl40.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 --spiral-vase \
    --output prusaslicer_vase_40mm.gcode cyl40.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 \
    --output prusaslicer_normal_6mm.gcode cyl6.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 --spiral-vase \
    --output prusaslicer_vase_6mm.gcode cyl6.stl

# Klipper flavor, with the layer markers Klipper's docs ask you to add
START='G28 ; home
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER=[total_layer_count]
M104 S200
M109 S200
G90
M83'
$PS --export-gcode --gcode-flavor klipper --use-relative-e-distances \
    --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 \
    --start-gcode "$START" --layer-gcode 'SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO CURRENT_LAYER={layer_num+1}' \
    --output klipper_normal_6mm.gcode cyl6.stl
# ...and again with --spiral-vase for klipper_vase_6mm.gcode
# ...and again with M82 instead of M83 in $START and without --use-relative-e-distances
#    for the klipper_absolute_* pair that sim/ compares

# The refusal cases
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 --arc-fitting emit_center \
    --output arcfit_normal_6mm.gcode cyl6.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.3 --first-layer-height 0.3 \
    --output mismatch_layerheight_6mm.gcode cyl6.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 --center 130,130 \
    --output shifted_placement_1mm.gcode cyl1.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 --duplicate 2 \
    --gcode-label-objects firmware --output two_objects_1mm.gcode cyl1.stl
$PS --export-gcode --layer-height 0.2 --first-layer-height 0.2 --binary-gcode \
    --output binary_6mm.bgcode cyl6.stl
```

BambuStudio takes the same shape of command as OrcaSlicer. The vase process profile is a copy of
`BBL/process/0.20mm Standard @BBL P1P.json` with the same four vase overrides:

```sh
$BAMBU --datadir bambu_data \
  --load-settings "$P/machine/Bambu Lab P1P 0.4 nozzle.json;$P/process/0.20mm Standard @BBL P1P.json" \
  --load-filaments "$P/filament/Generic PLA.json" \
  --slice 0 --outputdir out cyl40.stl
```

OrcaSlicer needs a machine, process and filament profile rather than flags. The vase profile is a
copy of `0.20mm Standard @Creality Ender3 0.4.json` with `spiral_mode` 1, `wall_loops` 1,
`top_shell_layers` 0 and `sparse_infill_density` `0%`. The Ender-3 machine profile's
`layer_change_gcode` has no `G92 E0`, which Orca refuses in relative-E mode, so it is overridden:

```sh
$ORCA --datadir orca_data \
  --load-settings "$P/machine/Creality Ender-3 0.4 nozzle.json;$P/process/0.20mm Standard @Creality Ender3 0.4.json" \
  --load-filaments "$P/filament/Creality Generic PLA @Ender-3V3-all.json" \
  --layer-change-gcode ';AFTER_LAYER_CHANGE
;[layer_z]
G92 E0' \
  --slice 0 --outputdir out cyl40.stl
```

`orca-slicer.exe` is a GUI subsystem binary on Windows, so it writes nothing to the console. Check
the output directory to see whether it worked.
